title: SQL Console — BOOKORDER

blocks.title: SQL
lines: SELECT O.ORDERNO, C.NAME, COUNT(I.ID) AS LINES, SUM(I.AMOUNT) AS TOTAL
JOIN SAP_TRAINING_BOOKORDER_BOOKORDERITEMS  AS I ON I.ORDER_ID = O.ID
JOIN SAP_TRAINING_BOOKORDER_CUSTOMERS       AS C ON C.ID = O.CUSTOMER_ID

blocks.text: 对账：BO-1001 = 8400 + 2800 + 4800 = 16000，与 OData 的 getOrderTotal(BO-1001) 一致。
